name: sticky-table
title: Sticky table
description: A table in its own scroll area with a sticky header and a pinned first column, edge shadows appearing only when there is more to scroll.
docs: Pass the Table parts (TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter) as children, not a Table, and a label for the scroll box. maxHeight sets where rows start to scroll under the header; stickyColumns pins up to three leading columns. A table scrolls sideways only when its columns want more room than the box has: give it a min-w through tableClassName or its cells whitespace-nowrap. scrollRef reaches the scrolling box.
